title: Contrary Quest: My First Quest! | GameDev Journal
excerpt: I am developing an RPG! Today, I introduce you to RPG Maker MV questing, with a little example! Watch this first - and have fun seeing how a world is while testing! So, here we are! This is a little post detailing the work I made for my first ever quest! I didn't want to refine it, and instead show you. The code for the quest is pretty complicated in form, but quite linear in content. A little peek inside the code! If you want to learn how to do the same in RPG Maker MV, check out my course...
